correctness.rationale: PASS: For E=K[R4], e_i e_j=e_(2j-i mod 4), right annihilator W=span(e0-e2,e1-e3) is intrinsic and dimension two over every field. For char K !=2, the U,W product (u+w)y=epsilon(y)u+delta(y)Hw forces block C=0, quotient A either identity or swap, and W-action D diagonal or antidiagonal; hence (K^××K^×)⋊C2. In char2, the exact multiplication (u,w)(v,z)=(lambda(v)u,lambda(v)w+N(u,v)) forces A=D=I or P and permits any lower-left C∈M2(K), giving M2(K)^+⋊C2, C↦PCP. Finite orders 2(q−1)^2 and 2q^4 follow. Reviewed standalone exhaustive F2/F3 enumeration: 576/186624 admissible block matrices and 32/8 automorphisms; bounded checks do not prove arbitrary-field claims, which rest on the explicit product identities.
